offline_verifier.replacement_surface: one internal canonical repository-path admission function used before reads by live collection, sandbox collection, retained reopen, recorded component lookup, and historical source-evidence lookup

replacement_contract.repository_root: Normalized lexical REPO must equal strict resolved REPO.
replacement_contract.containment_before_read: Every candidate normalized lexical path must be inside canonical REPO before any content read.
replacement_contract.no_symlink_components: Strict resolved path must equal normalized lexical path, rejecting final or ancestor symlinks before content read.
replacement_contract.canonical_relative_rows: Retained source rows must use one canonical repository-relative spelling with no absolute, dot, dot-dot, redundant separator, or alias spelling.
replacement_contract.duplicate_rule: Every occurrence is validated; identical canonical lexical repeats may coalesce to the canonical lexical Path; all other aliases reject.
replacement_contract.consumer_rule: Creation, historical sandboxing, retained reopen, component-root reconstruction, and historical source evidence use the same admission function.

loop_breaker.next_action: Replace the validator family once, obtain fresh adversarial falsification, then run a fresh complete zero-call suite only if the replacement has zero blocker.
